title: Two Leaders
text: After a network blip, two nodes each believe they are the leader, and both are sending heartbeats.
held: The higher term led; the other noticed and stood down.

cards.label: Reject it and reply with the higher term
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: from
fields.value: a node that says it leads

fields.label: term
fields.check: Compare its term with the highest you have seen
fields.ok: Term 6: nothing higher has reached you.

intrusion.detail: This heartbeat is from term 5. You have seen term 6.
intrusion.correct: Reject it and reply with the higher term
intrusion.why: Two nodes may believe they lead, but only one term is the latest. The reply is how the old one finds out.
intrusion.reveal: The heartbeat came from the leader of term 5, after term 6 had begun.

cards.label: Step down
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: term in the reply
fields.check: Read the term in the reply

intrusion.why: A leader holds the role only for its own term. Seeing a higher one ends it; there is nothing to argue.
intrusion.reveal: Follower B's reply showed a newer term than the Leader's.

temptations.label: Keep leading until an operator decides between you
temptations.why: Waiting for a person means two leaders in the meantime. The term number is the decision.

teaches: There can be two nodes that think they lead, but only one whose term is current.
Stepping down on a higher term is automatic. No negotiation, no operator.

question.text: Before play: what settles which of two leaders is the real one?
question.why: Terms only go up, and a majority voted in the newest one. Everything from an older term is refused.
